book.name: ROM
book.title: ROM Rom mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Kuate nu nuŋe wamdus dubimba nuŋe mbal madiniŋgit
Ye Kristus tuku taŋgo minet ta ye yabri pasa sa ndaket. Ye pasa satiŋgamŋgit te siŋka son pasa. Tukul Guwaŋge pasa te siŋka son pasa ŋga sayate le ye tane satiŋget ta teŋenmba.
Ye Zu mbal tuku piti suŋgoyate le ŋgamuŋgal rar kamusmba minet.
Ye Kristus ndoŋ purka ŋgisikumba maŋau tambi yiŋe ndare tuma turkam kumuŋ kande ye wam ta mata iduset kande.

Nane Israel tugu minig. Nane nuŋe kiŋo kame minam tuku Kuateŋge nane madiniŋgina. Nu nane ndoŋ minmba minit. Nu nuŋe pasa ta nane ndoŋ katna. Nane tukul pasa ŋak. Kuate mbariŋam tuku ndin nu nane tumniŋgina. Nu wam magenu kam sakina ta nane amboŋga ismba tinaig.

Abraham Isak Yakob nane nane tuku mbuŋ. Kristus nu ŋgarosu ŋak mayok kina ta nu nane tuku ndare mbolŋge mayok kina. Nu Kuate. Nu agaŋ ŋakmba kulatka minit. Nyu te-duŋgam tuku wam ta nu mbolŋge kumba minmba minam tuku minit. Son.
Israel mbal nane Kuate tuku ndin pitaide tukunu Kuate nu wam kam saniŋgina ta ke ndakate ŋga idus ndawap. Nane Israel tuku tugu ŋakmba minig ta afu ndo Israel ndinok.
Ta tuku Abraham tuku mbuŋ ŋakmba minig ta afu ndo nu tuku mbuŋ ndinok. Kuate nu teŋenmba Abraham sana.

content.text: Isak tuku ndare mbolŋge ndo ne tuku mbuŋ mayok kaŋgaig ŋga sana. Mulum Pasa 21.12

content: Pasa ta tugunu teŋenmba. Sine ŋgarosu mbolŋge Abraham tuku mbuŋ mayok kineg mbal sine Kuate tuku kiŋo kame mayok nda kineg. Kuate nu pasa saŋgrinu Abraham sana ta sine pasa ta mbolŋge Abraham tuku mbuŋ mayok kineg mbal ndo sine Kuate tuku kiŋo mayok kineg. Sine Abraham tuku mbuŋ ndinok.
Kuate nu Abraham teŋenmba sana.

content.text: Yar ande si piyo naŋe Sara nu kiŋo tuwa le ye siŋka luka prowamŋgit ŋgina. Mulum Pasa 18.10

content: Ta ndo kuga. Ŋgumneŋga Rebeka nu siŋgine mbuŋ Isak ndoŋ kiŋo armba fuŋgul sinamŋge konkinaik.

Kiŋo armba ta pro ndamba wam magenu ko ŋaigonu ke ndakinaik le nu o buk ande madina. Kuate nu taŋgo madiniŋgit ta nane wam ke likade mbolŋge madi ndaniŋmba nu nuŋe wamdus ndo dubimba madiniŋmba wikate.
Nu nuŋe maŋau ta te-mayokmba Rebeka teŋenmba sana.

content.text: Kiŋo mulum nu kiŋo ŋgumneŋgamŋgat ta tuku miŋge kumnemŋge minamŋgat ŋga sana. Mulum Pasa 25.23

content: Kuyar pasa ande mbolŋge Kuate tuku miŋge teŋenmba minit.

content.text: Yakob tuku ye kume puret ta Esau ye kasuret ŋgate. Malakai 1.2

content: Kuate nu nuŋe nzali dubimba ande madimba ande pitaite ta nu wam kumumbi ke ndakate ŋga sakam kumuŋ e? i ... Ye taŋamba idus ndawet.
Kuate nu pasa te Moses sana le nu kuyar mbolŋge kuyarna le minit.

content.text: Ye taŋgo ande mapewam iduset ta ye nu mapewet.
Ye taŋgo ande sinawam iduset ta ye nu sinawet ŋgate. Kisim Bek 33.19

content: Ta tuku Kuate nu ande mapete ta taŋgo tuku wamdus ko nuŋe piro tuku mundu ta tuku nu mape ndate. Kuga. Nu nuŋe wamdus sina tambi ndo nu mapete.
Kuate nu kuyar pasa ande mbolŋge Isip tuku gabat Farao tuku teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ye ne mbolŋge yiŋe saŋgri te-mayoki le ye tuku nyu kilke mbol mbal iswaig ŋga ye ne gabat pilen ŋgate. Kisim Bek 9.16

content: Ata. Kuate nu nuŋe nzali dubimba afu mapekate sulumba afu nuŋe pasa pitaiwam tuku wamdus kareŋnu niŋgit.
Kile tane tuku ande teŋenmba ye kusnayamŋgat. Sine Kuate tuku nzali pitaiwam kumuŋ kuga ta ndaŋam saka Kuate nu taŋgo tuku gubra pilit ŋga ye kusnayuwa ta
ye teŋenmba nu tuku pasa lafuwamŋgit. Ne ima le Kuate ndoŋ kualeyaukate. Kilke waim andeŋge nu taŋgo wakeite ta samba ne ndaŋam saka ye teŋenmba wakeiyina ŋga sa ndate.
Waim wakeikanu taŋgo ta nu kilke kilmba nuŋe nzali ndo dubimba agaŋ wakeikate. Nu kilke ndui tambi waim ande maditaknu wakeimba waim ande ake agaŋ patinu tuku wakeite.

Taŋamba ndo Kuate nu nuŋe nzali dubimba nuŋe agaŋ ndende mbolŋge wam afu kam kumuŋ. Nu une tuku gubra ŋak minmba nuŋe saŋgri suŋgo te-mayokmba ŋakmba tumniŋgam tuku iduste ta nu ŋgan minmba pitik ndo ŋgisikam tuku minig mbal pa niŋge ndakate.
Nu nuŋe mapekate mbal mbolŋge nuŋe wam magenu lato lato patikuwa le ŋakmba kaŋgerwaig ŋga idusmba taŋate. Mbal ta nane nu ndoŋ gare ŋak minmba minam tuku Kuate nu o buk nane madiniŋgina.
Kuate nu sine wike likate mbal tuku saket ta afu Zu mbal afu kasomok mbal.
Kuate nu tuan taŋgo Hosea mbolŋge nu kasomok mbal tuku teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Nane ye tuku mbal mine ndakade kuasmbi ta nane ye tuku mbal minamŋgaig. Mbal ta ye nane wamdus niŋge ndaken ta ye nane tuku kume purmba minamŋgit.
Ma ande tuku mbal nane Kuate tuku mbal kuga ŋga saken ta ye tane Kuate abo ŋak minit tuku kiŋo kame ŋgamŋgit. Hosea 2.23; 1.10

content: Kuate nu taŋamba sakina.
Tuan taŋgo Aisaia nu Israel mbal tuku teŋenmba wi kueŋka sakina.

content.text: Piyalŋge fulbul minig taŋaŋ Israel mbal burnu kumuŋ kuga ta ndui ndui ndo muskil kile-tidiŋgam tuku wam tamŋgaig.
Kuate nu dal ndaka kilke te mbolŋge pitik ndo pasa nduiye te-timba lafunu pa niŋgamŋgat. Aisaia 10.22-23

content: Aisaia nu o buk pasa ande teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Samba mbolok mbal tuku Mbara nu sine tuku ndare afu mape ndakina kande sine Sodom le Gomora taŋaŋ kile mine ndakeg kande. Aisaia 1.9

content: Aisaia nu taŋamba sakina.

Ye tuan taŋgo kame tuku pasa satiŋgit ta tugunu teŋenmba. Kasomok mbal nane tiŋreknu mayok kambim tuku ndin sota matuk tukul ndakinaig ta nane Kuate nu kumuŋ ŋginaig sulumba Kuate am mbolŋge tiŋreknu mayok kinaig.
Israel mbal nane tiŋreknu mayok kambim tuku tukul dubika matuk tukulka nane tiŋreknu mayok ndakinaig.

Ta ndaŋam? Nane tiŋreknu mayok kambim tuku wamdus saŋgrinu pilnaig ta naŋgine piro tuku saŋgri mbolŋge sotinaig. Kuate nu kumuŋ ŋga nu mbolŋge sote ndakinaig. Ndame ande taŋgo kupe daŋŋgade ta nane ndame ta mbolŋge bikekade.
Kuyar pasa nu teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Ata. Ye Sion tumbraŋŋge ndame ande kupe daŋŋgam tuku pili le minamŋgat. Ndame suŋgo ta mbolŋge nane barinuŋgaig. Ande nu ndame ta tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋguwa ta nu tumail pulunuŋgat ŋgate. Aisaia 28.16
